demo.title: get-tape.sh
demo.code:
# Every tracked stock token on Base vs the real stock (free, no key)
curl -s -X POST https://afterbook.app/api/mcp \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"get_tape","arguments":{}}}'

setup: Install the skill. No API key, account or funds are needed for the free MCP server or the short index at afterbook.app/llms.txt.
Ask something like: "which Coinbase stock token on Base has the biggest gap right now?"
For a buy, open the plan or basket link Afterbook returns and sign in your own wallet (not available in the US or its territories).
